### 1. Architecture Overview
The storage extension contract that OTel Collector components (and downstream consumers like Jaeger contrib and Tempo’s Jaeger plugin) rely on lives in the core OTel Collector repo (`extension/xextension/storage`). The interface `Extension` (with `GetClient`) and `Client` (Get/Set/Delete/Batch/Close) are defined there; collectors and extensions in contrib implement/consume this to wire storage backends (file/redis/db/etc.). To add archive support for Jaeger-compatible backends, the new method must be added to this core contract because contrib’s Jaeger components and Tempo’s Jaeger plugin depend on it for trace storage. Downstream storage extensions in contrib (file/redis/db) implement this interface today and will need to add the new method signature. Jaeger’s storage extension (in the Jaeger repo) pulls factories via this contract; Tempo’s Jaeger plugin uses the storage backend API to satisfy Jaeger queries.

### 2. Detailed Analysis
- Core interface location: `opentelemetry-collector` repo, file `extension/xextension/storage/storage.go`.
  - Defines `type Extension interface { extension.Extension; GetClient(ctx context.Context, kind component.Kind, id component.ID, storageName string) (Client, error) }` (lines 14-23). This is the interface you must change by adding `GetArchiveStorage(ctx context.Context) (tracestorage.Reader, tracestorage.Writer, error)` (or the exact signature requested).
  - `Client` interface supports Get/Set/Delete/Batch/Close with map-like semantics (lines 25-55).
  - Operation helpers are below (SetOperation/GetOperation/DeleteOperation).
- Interface documentation: `extension/xextension/storage/README.md` (core repo) describes the same contract and batch helpers; this should be updated to document the new archive method.

Downstream implementers in contrib that will break if the interface changes:
- `opentelemetry-collector-contrib`:
  - File-based storage extension: `extension/storage/filestorage/extension.go` implements the storage extension interface.
  - Redis storage extension: `extension/storage/redisstorageextension/extension.go` implements the storage extension interface.
  - DB storage extension: `extension/storage/dbstorage/extension.go` implements the storage extension interface.
  - Test doubles: `extension/storage/storagetest/extension.go` (mock extension) and `extension/storage/storagetest/client.go`.
  - Stanza adapter utilities that obtain storage clients: `pkg/stanza/adapter/storage.go`.
- Jaeger repo:
  - Jaeger storage extension: `cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/jaegerstorage/extension.go` uses the storage extension/factories to expose trace/metric storage; adding a new method to the interface will require an implementation or forwarding to the underlying storage factory.
  - Jaeger query service uses archive storage: `cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/jaegerquery/querysvc/service.go` (uses primary and archive storage; adding the new method gives a unified contract).
- Tempo repo:
  - Jaeger storage plugin: `cmd/tempo-query/tempo/plugin.go` implements a Jaeger storage backend adapter; it will need to support the new archive storage accessor to comply with the updated interface.

### 3. Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| opentelemetry-collector | extension/xextension/storage/storage.go | Defines the `Extension` interface to be modified; add `GetArchiveStorage(ctx context.Context) (tracestorage.Reader, tracestorage.Writer, error)` here. |
| opentelemetry-collector | extension/xextension/storage/README.md | Documents the storage extension contract; must be updated to describe the new archive method. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | extension/storage/filestorage/extension.go | Implements the storage extension interface; must add the new method. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | extension/storage/redisstorageextension/extension.go | Implements the storage extension interface; must add the new method. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | extension/storage/dbstorage/extension.go | Implements the storage extension interface; must add the new method. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | extension/storage/storagetest/extension.go | Test double for storage extension; must add the new method to stay in sync. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | extension/storage/storagetest/client.go | Client/test support; may need changes if the test extension provides archive functionality. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | pkg/stanza/adapter/storage.go | Retrieves storage clients; verify or extend usage for archive retrieval if needed. |
| jaeger | cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/jaegerstorage/extension.go | Jaeger storage extension uses the storage contract; must implement/forward the new archive storage method. |
| jaeger | cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/jaegerquery/querysvc/service.go | Query service integrates archive storage; will rely on the new method for archive reader/writer. |
| tempo | cmd/tempo-query/tempo/plugin.go | Tempo’s Jaeger storage plugin backend; must implement the new archive storage accessors for Jaeger compatibility. |

Implementation notes:
- Update the interface in `storage.go`; import the appropriate `tracestorage` package.
- Adjust all implementers to satisfy the new method and return appropriate archive reader/writer or an error if unsupported.
- Update README/docs and any tests that embed mock storage extensions.
